item.title: Chelmsford jeweller to close store after more than 50 years
item.description: Retail Jeweller Chelmsford jeweller to close store after more than 50 years Independent retailer Krafft Jewellers has announced it will close its Chelmsford store after more than five decades in business, citing challenging trading conditions, rising costs and the continued growth of online shopping. Chelmsford jeweller to close store after more than 50 years Ruth Faulkner

item.description: Retail Jeweller Georg Jensen expands flagship store at The Royal Exchange Danish jewellery brand Georg Jensen has expanded its presence at The Royal Exchange in the City of London, relocating to a larger flagship unit following strong trading performance at the luxury destination. item.title: Pandora unveils platinum plated jewellery expansion alongside senior leadership appointment
item.description: Retail Jeweller Pandora unveils platinum plated jewellery expansion alongside senior leadership appointment Pandora has announced plans to introduce platinum plated jewellery to its global portfolio, marking a significant expansion of the precious metals used across its collections as the brand looks to strengthen its position in accessible luxury and reduce reliance on sterling silver. item.title: Goldsmiths’ Centre appoints Julia Balchin as interim director
item.description: Retail Jeweller Goldsmiths’ Centre appoints Julia Balchin as interim director The Goldsmiths’ Centre has announced the appointment of Julia Balchin as interim director, with the former Royal Drawing School principal set to take up the position in March 2026, succeeding outgoing director Peter Taylor MBE.
